task.description:
Rework 2 — Fix the single remaining Y132 issue in templates/specs/obp-01-plat-outbox-gate-depth-ts.migration.yaml.

**ONLY this file needs to change.** All 4 design markdown files are already passing.

The problem: all test_cases[*].assertions entries use a YAML list format:
  assertions:
    - row_count: 1

The correct format used by every other migration YAML in templates/specs/ is a block scalar:
  assertions: |
    // CUSTOM: describe what to verify here

Fix: change all 4 test_cases[*].assertions values from YAML list to block scalar with a descriptive // CUSTOM: placeholder.

After fixing, verify:
1. python tools/lint_design_artefact.py templates/specs/obp-01-plat-outbox-gate-depth-ts.migration.yaml exits 0
2. python tools/codegen_migration.py templates/specs/obp-01-plat-outbox-gate-depth-ts.migration.yaml --dry-run exits 0 (if this tool exists)

No other files need changing.

validator_failures.MAJOR_Y132: test_cases assertions must be block scalar 'assertions: |' with '// CUSTOM:' placeholder, not a YAML list
